definitions.decomposition: Phi = D - F with D = V_vac - Vbar, F = E_F - Vbar; V(z) plane-averaged ionic+Hartree potential, V_vac the two-face vacuum mean of Eq. (S8), Vbar the mean of V(z) between the outermost atomic planes (main) and over those planes extended by 1 A on each side (sensitivity). Static24 jobs, parent in-plane lattice (clamped).
definitions.pair change: dX = X(candidate) - X(parent) for X in Phi, D, F.
definitions.valence count: N = group number for groups 1-12, group - 10 for groups 13-18; dN = N(substituent) - N(host) for one M-site substitution.
definitions.early host: host metal of groups 3-6 (Sc, Y, Ti, Zr, Hf, Nb, Ta, Mo, W).
definitions.flagged pairs: two-face difference > 0.1 eV or |magnetization| > 0.1 muB in either system: reported separately, excluded from tests.

hypotheses.H1_sign_rule: In early hosts, single M-site substitutions with dN != 0 change Phi with sign opposite to dN (electron addition lowers Phi). Formulated from the contrast set (8/8); tested only on pairs computed after this lock (round 1, round 2, design). Supported if the sign agreement exceeds 50% with a one-sided binomial p < 0.05.
hypotheses.H2_filling_term: In early hosts, dF has the sign of dN (electron addition raises E_F relative to the slab-mean potential) in a majority of pairs, and -dF tracks dPhi more closely than dD does: Spearman(dPhi, -dF) > Spearman(dPhi, dD). Tested on all early-host pairs (contrast, round 1, round 2, design); reported for both Vbar windows.
hypotheses.H3_model_variable: The C2DB-trained ensemble identifies valence count as the controlling variable but with the inter-compound sign: within early hosts its predicted change correlates positively with dN (Spearman > 0 in all five members). Reported on the same pairs as H2.

not_claimed: Late hosts (groups 8-12) and the p-block host Sb2Se2 are reported descriptively; no sign rule is asserted for them.
